title: Flex Containers and Direction
ques: Explain how setting **`display: flex`** initializes a Flex Container. Demonstrate how `flex-direction` (`row`, `column`, `row-reverse`, `column-reverse`) controls the main axis.
explanation: `display: flex` establishes a flex formatting context for direct children. `flex-direction` determines the primary layout axis along which items are placed.

title: Flex Items: Grow, Shrink, and Basis
ques: Explain the three sub-properties of the **`flex`** shorthand on flex items: **`flex-grow`**, **`flex-shrink`**, and **`flex-basis`**. Write a rule for a responsive sidebar layout.
explanation: `flex-grow` allocates free space, `flex-shrink` dictates how items compress under tight space, and `flex-basis` establishes initial size before distribution.

title: Flexbox Alignment: Justify-Content and Align-Items
ques: Explain how to align flex items along both the main axis (**`justify-content`**) and cross axis (**`align-items`**). Write a snippet perfectly centering a hero dialog.
explanation: `justify-content` distributes items along the main axis (`flex-start`, `center`, `space-between`), while `align-items` aligns along the cross axis (`stretch`, `center`, `baseline`).

title: CSS Grid Containers and Tracks
ques: Explain how to create a 2D layout with **`display: grid`**, **`grid-template-columns`**, and the fractional unit **`fr`**.
explanation: CSS Grid manages two-dimensional layouts simultaneously. The `fr` unit represents a fraction of available space, and `repeat(auto-fit, minmax())` delivers responsive column wrapping without media queries.

title: Named Grid Template Areas
ques: Demonstrate the use of **`grid-template-areas`** and **`grid-area`** to assemble a full page layout with header, sidebar, main content, and footer.
explanation: `grid-template-areas` allows mapping named grid areas visually in CSS, making page layout composition readable and maintainable.
